Hana Ito: Heads-up — Seaworthy wants a short migration POC to validate compatibility with their current API and to get security questionnaire answers + a migration credit.
Elliot Park: What endpoints do they use?
Hana Ito: POST /v1/stream_text (chunked) with a custom header X-Org-Context and strict stop-token semantics. They also set model via X-Model-Tag.
Rahul Desai: We can proxy and re-chunk to match their framing. Suggest a small shim that copies X-Org-Context into metadata and re-emits chunks to match their boundaries.
Marta Silva: Also watch tokenization differences — they use a legacy tokenizer which truncates earlier. We should run a 300-sample tokenization parity check focused on HTML inputs.
sec-bot: Auto-reply: "HSM import supported on Dedicated/Private. KMS and key-wrap available. SOC2 report available via legal portal."
Elliot Park: Commercial ask: Seaworthy wants temporary price parity for the migration window. Sales suggests 20% off hosted for first 30 days + $6k migration credit if they sign Dedicated LOI within 3 months. POC cap $1,200.
Hana Ito: Ops requirement: p95 < 300ms for 256 tokens. Hosted generally meets this but p99 spikes. Recommend a 48h Dedicated smoke window during the POC.
Rahul Desai: I'll run the parity harness and scaffold the shim. Will flag any stop-token mismatches and >1-token tokenization deltas.
Marta Silva: I'll draft the vendor questionnaire answers and include sample audit log lines and key residency language.
Elliot Park: Timeline: Seaworthy wants results in 5 business days. Can we do that?
Rahul Desai: Tight but doable if Legal and Finance approve the bridge offer tomorrow. I'll prioritize parity runs.
Hana Ito: Action items:
- Rahul: parity diffs + failing prompt samples by EOD (3170030000)
- Marta: security checklist answers before kickoff
- Elliot: draft commercial terms + SOW skeleton
sec-bot: Note: For HSM imports allow a 5-business-day lead time for key onboarding on Dedicated/Private.
Hana Ito: Scheduling kickoff for tomorrow 11am PT. I'll attach the SOW and parity doc. Flag blockers here and I'll escalate. :thumbsup:
